title: The Quiet Letter
author: E. M. Amberdale
blurb: Oscar Montrose, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
